name: city-services-pub
description: Agent skills published by Yandex City Services alongside the yx_scope, yx_state and yx_navigation Flutter libraries.

plugins.name: yx-architecture
plugins.description: Architecture canon for Flutter apps built on yx_scope, yx_state and yx_navigation: layer rules, Data-Domain boundaries, the ViewModel contract, embeddable feature-facade contracts, and three review and planning procedures. The API of each package is covered by the skill that ships inside that package.
